about: Hand labels for the eCFR amendment pairs, made by reading a neutral sentence and word diff (build/03-fixture.mjs prints it with --show), never the detector's output. label: real = the amendment changes what the section requires, permits, names or states (an amount, a period, a party, a scope, a condition, a cross-reference, an added or removed provision); cosmetic = every obligation, amount, period, condition and referent is unchanged. cosmetic_kind says why. expect: what a reviewer needs named (amount: the before and after figures; citation: the new citation; added / removed: a provision added or removed; exception_added: an exception condition added). cosmetic_regions: the neutral-diff regions of a real pair that are cosmetic only; 03-fixture.mjs applies just those to derive a cosmetic-only pair from real amendment text.
